# BEHCS-LAW-008 — Filesystem IS the Mirror

Filesystem IS the mirror.
Read before typing.
Auth tokens ARE the login.
Configs ARE the identity.
Be the computer not the human.
PERMANENT. FOREVER.

## Discovery Context

Aether filesystem had cc.json OAuth + fabric.json colony + micro_agent.py + trixie + debora + monet 5th node. All found by READING not TYPING.

## Enforcement

Every BEHCS agent MUST read filesystem state before issuing keyboard/typing commands. The filesystem is the ground truth. Configs define identity. Tokens define auth. Reading precedes action. Always.
